title: Urad Dal Makhani
subtitle: Creamy black urad dal, tempered with hing and ginger in place of onion and garlic.
protein: ~14–16g protein per adult serving — from urad dal

nightPrep.label: Night Before
items: Rinse whole black urad dal {1½ cups} and soak in plenty of water at least 6 hours, or overnight
Drain before pressure cooking

method.title: Pressure-cook the dal
items: Drain soaked urad dal and add to the pressure cooker with water {3 cups}
Add turmeric {¾ tsp} and salt {1 tsp}
Pressure cook 5–6 whistles on medium heat, until dal is soft and starting to break down
Once pressure releases naturally, mash lightly with the back of a ladle for a creamier texture — leave some texture, don't purée

method.title: Build the gravy, combine with dal
items: Heat ghee {3 tbsp} in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat
Add cumin seeds {1 tsp} and let them sizzle 10 seconds
Add hing {¼ tsp} and grated ginger {1½ tbsp}, sauté 30 seconds until fragrant
Add celery {3 tbsp}, sauté 2 minutes until softened — it's standing in for the aromatic bulk onion would give, don't skip it
Add tomato paste {4 tbsp}, cook 4–5 minutes until the raw smell is gone and ghee separates at the edges
Add the cooked dal from Step 1; stir well, adding water as needed to reach a thick, creamy consistency
Simmer uncovered on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally so it doesn't catch at the bottom

method.label: Toddler — pull before any chili goes in
items: Scoop out a small bowl (about ¾ cup) of the plain dal now, before spicing
Mash in boiled potato {3 tbsp} and a small pat of butter {½ tsp} for extra calories and softness
Hing is fine for her — no need to skip it. Set this bowl aside; it needs no further cooking.

method.title: Spice the remaining adult portion
items: To the pan with the remaining dal, add Kashmiri chili powder {1½ tsp}
Add garam masala {1 tsp} and sugar {¼ tsp}, stir to combine
Simmer 5 more minutes on low heat

method.title: Finish the dal
items: Stir in crushed kasuri methi {1½ tbsp}
Stir in cream {⅓ cup} and butter {2 tbsp}
Adjust salt to taste
Simmer 2 more minutes on low heat, then turn off

method.title: Cool and store for meal prep
items: Let the dal cool to room temperature before refrigerating
Store in an airtight container — keeps well for 4–5 days refrigerated
Reheat gently on the stovetop, adding a splash of water or milk to loosen the texture if it's thickened

method.label: Notes
method.text: Use the stovetop pressure cooker for the dal — it needs less water than open-pot cooking and gives the creamy, broken-down texture dal makhani needs. Build the gravy in a separate pan; the Instant Pot's sauté mode works too if you'd rather do it all in one pot. Serve with rice, roti, or jeera rice, plus a simple stir-fried seasonal vegetable. The sugar isn't for sweetness — it's a traditional balancing touch that rounds out the tang from tomato and bitterness from kasuri methi.
